title: Conformally flat factorization homology in Ind-Hilbert spaces and Conformal field theory
summary: We introduce a metric-dependent geometric variant of factorization homology in conformally flat Riemannian geometry for $d \geq 2$. Its coefficients are symmetric monoidal functors from a disk category in conformal Riemannian geometry to the ind-category of Hilbert spaces, which we call conformally flat $d$-disk algebras. We prove that their left Kan extensions define symmetric monoidal invariants of conformally flat manifolds.
